target_buyer.why_top_candidate: Active local food market with 50+ vendors, demonstration kitchen, and classes. Located in Ashtabula Harbor at 1022 Bridge Street. General store building community around self-reliance, food security, and local ecosystems. Owned by T Gallo (nurse practitioner). High community engagement with cooking classes, canning workshops, and local food advocacy.
